subject: Social Media
title: Algorithmic Amplification
description: A fast breakdown of Algorithmic Amplification for builders.

hook.text: A hate group posts a video. Ten people share it. The algorithm detects engagement and shows it to ten million.

buildup.text: Algorithms don't judge content quality. They measure engagement. Outrage, fear, and hate engage powerfully.

discovery.text: Facebook's own research found its algorithm recommended extremist groups to 64% of those who joined. It radicalized.

twist.text: Removing the content is one solution. Removing the amplification is another. The algorithm is the weapon, not the post.

climax.text: Some researchers propose 'friction': slowing sharing of unverified content. Speed kills truth. Friction saves it.

punchline.text: Content doesn't go viral. Algorithms make it go viral.

quiz.question: What did Facebook's research find about its algorithm?
options: It recommended extremist groups to most who joined them
